notes: The page's blocked-members list, at rest and empty (#977). `origin` is the title in both states, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the first row at rest and the empty sentence when there is none, because those are the regions both clients draw identically. The list needs a session with at least one blocked member, and the empty state needs one with none, so a recording has to sign in as the fixture account and arrange that data. The surface is declared here and not yet under `docs/mobile/visual-gate.json`, which is why it is ported and switched off (#977, ADR-0117). Widths of the name and handle are left out deliberately - they are the run of the words, not a decision. Colours are left out too - they are what the raster proves.

motion.notes: The blocked list is still. The Unblock control fades its border and background on hover and dims while disabled; the same means the same 150ms colour transition, with no travel and no layout change. Loading is a spinner.
